text:
China’s BYD will build new factories in Europe for a bigger market share, as the world’s largest electric vehicle (EV) maker faces fiscal support pullback at home and rising trade barriers overseas, according to an executive.
“Europe is a very important regional market for BYD. We will not let tariff increases affect local consumers’ choice of BYD,” said Liu
text_zh:
比亚迪高管表示，作为全球最大的电动汽车制造商，比亚迪将在欧洲新建工厂以扩大市场份额，原因是公司在国内面临财政支持退坡，在海外面临贸易壁垒上升。
“欧洲对比亚迪来说是非常重要的区域市场。我们不会让关税上调影响当地消费者选择比亚迪，”刘说。
